deploymentNote: Design-only query catalog. This is not a Fabric KQLDashboard Git export and must not be imported or staged as one.
name: Retail Ops - Real-Time
description: Design-only query catalog for a retail operations dashboard

tiles.title: Sales/min by Store (1h)
tiles.query: mv_store_sales_minute | where ts > ago(60m) | summarize total_sales=sum(total_sales) by store_id | top 10 by total_sales desc

tiles.title: Online Orders (15m)
tiles.query: let window=15m; online_order_created | where ingest_timestamp > ago(window) | summarize orders=count(), subtotal=sum(subtotal), tax=sum(tax), total=sum(total) | extend aov=toreal(total)/toreal(orders) | project orders, aov, total

tiles.title: Fulfillment Pipeline (24h)
tiles.query: let window=24h; let created_count=toscalar(online_order_created | where ingest_timestamp > ago(window) | summarize count()); let picked_count=toscalar(online_order_picked | where ingest_timestamp > ago(window) | summarize count()); let shipped_count=toscalar(online_order_shipped | where ingest_timestamp > ago(window) | summarize count()); print created=created_count, picked=picked_count, shipped=shipped_count

tiles.title: BLE Presence (30m)
tiles.query: let window=30m; ble_ping_detected | where ingest_timestamp > ago(window) | summarize devices=dcount(customer_ble_id) by store_id | top 10 by devices desc

tiles.title: Marketing Cost (24h)
tiles.query: let window=24h; ad_impression | where ingest_timestamp > ago(window) | summarize impressions=count(), cost=sum(cost) by campaign_id | top 10 by cost desc

tiles.title: Tender Mix (15m)
tiles.query: payment_processed | where ingest_timestamp > ago(15m) | summarize amount=sum(amount) by payment_method | order by amount desc

tiles.title: Top Products (15m)
tiles.query: let window=15m; receipt_line_added | where ingest_timestamp > ago(window) | summarize revenue=sum(extended_price) by product_id | top 10 by revenue desc

tiles.title: Stockout Detections (24h)
tiles.query: stockout_detected | where ingest_timestamp > ago(24h) | summarize detections=count(), affected_products=dcount(product_id) by store_id | top 10 by detections desc

tiles.title: Zone Arrivals and Weighted Dwell (30m)
tiles.query: mv_zone_dwell_minute | where ts > ago(30m) | summarize arrivals=sum(customers), dwell_seconds_weighted=sum(todouble(avg_dwell)*todouble(customers)) by zone | extend avg_dwell_seconds=iif(arrivals==0, real(null), dwell_seconds_weighted/todouble(arrivals)) | project zone, arrivals, avg_dwell_seconds | top 10 by arrivals desc

tiles.title: Truck Dwell by Site (24h)
tiles.query: fn_truck_sla() | where departure_ingest_timestamp > ago(24h) | where departure_ingest_timestamp <= now() | where departure_time <= now() | summarize avg_dwell_min=avg(dwell_minutes) by site | top 10 by avg_dwell_min desc
